title: Build a list
prompt: Start with an empty array. Append a, then b, then c to it. Return the array.
hints: append adds one item to the end.

docs.name: list.append(value)
docs.what: Adds value to the end of the array. Returns nothing.

solution:
func solve(a, b, c):
	var items = []
	items.append(a)
	items.append(b)
	items.append(c)
	return items
